title: Slices from Raw Pointers
goal: Construct a slice from a raw pointer using unsafe functions.

source.attribution: adapted from Unsafe Rust: Dereferencing Raw Pointers

hints: Constructing a slice from a raw pointer assumes memory safety that the compiler cannot verify.
Check whether your raw pointer is immutable or mutable when picking the standard slice function.
explanation: Calling `slice::from_raw_parts` is unsafe because the caller must guarantee memory validity, so calling it outside `unsafe` triggers compiler error `E0133`. Passing a `*const i32` to `from_raw_parts_mut` causes a type mismatch error `E0308` because mutable slices require mutable pointers. Calling `from_ref` causes type and argument count mismatch errors.
